name: immich-machine-learning-cuda
description: Immich Machine Learning service with NVIDIA CUDA GPU acceleration. Requires an NVIDIA GPU (Pascal generation or newer) with the NVIDIA Container Toolkit installed on the Unraid host. Handles face recognition, CLIP-based image search, and OCR using GPU-accelerated inference. Must be on the same Docker network as the Immich server.

paths.name: Path: Model Cache
paths.description: ML model cache directory. Models are downloaded on first use (several GB).

variables.name: MACHINE_LEARNING_MODEL_TTL
variables.description: Seconds of inactivity before unloading models from VRAM. Set to 0 to keep loaded permanently.

variables.name: MACHINE_LEARNING_WORKERS
variables.description: Number of ML worker processes. For multi-GPU setups, increase workers and set MACHINE_LEARNING_DEVICE_IDS (e.g. 0,1) to distribute workers across GPUs.

variables.name: MACHINE_LEARNING_WORKER_TIMEOUT
variables.description: Seconds before a worker is considered unresponsive. GPU inference can be slow on first run.

variables.name: IMMICH_LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Log verbosity: verbose, debug, log, warn, error
